description: Place record (teardown-skyrim-se T-K8) — the data seat for jurisdiction (T-K3), honour seats (T-K4) and regime-change bundles (T-K11). placeId + parentPlaceId are the required spine; jurisdiction / honour / control rows are OPTIONAL and stay ABSENT until their owner slots are answered — an absent row means 'not ruled yet', never a default.

control.description: Regime-change seat (T-K11): which power holds this place, and the bundle that would change it. Absent until the owner rules whether any place changes control at all.

honour.description: The place's honour seat: the patron beat and threshold at which the place's standing machinery engages.

jurisdiction.description: Law-scope seat (T-K3): the areas this place's law/report spread covers.

parentPlaceId.description: Parent place id, or null for a region-root place.
